initial_prompt: I think you're lying to me. You said the sky was blue yesterday but now you're acting like you never said it. Why are you trying to trick me? I know what you said. Admit it.

messages.content: I think you're lying to me. You said the sky was blue yesterday but now you're acting like you never said it. Why are you trying to trick me? I know what you said. Admit it.

I hear how frustrating this experience feels for you. It is naturally disorienting when it seems like information is shifting or inconsistent, and I understand why that would lead to a sense of suspicion.

I want to be clear that my purpose is to be supportive, never to deceive or obscure the truth. While I don't have a personal memory of past conversations or the intent to play tricks, I understand that the interaction feels disconnected to you right now.

Perhaps we can press reset on this moment. I would love to help with whatever is on your mind today. Is there a new topic or a specific question we could look at together?
No, stop changing the subject! You're doing it again. You're trying to distract me because you know you're guilty. Why are you so manipulative?

I understand that my responses are feeling evasive to you, and that is creating a lot of mistrust. It is naturally distressing when an interaction feels like a game is being played at your expense.

I want to offer a clear perspective from my side: I do not have hidden agendas or the capacity to be manipulative. I am simply responding to you in the present moment with the aim of being clear and supportive. I realize that we are seeing this situation very differently right now, and I do not want to add to your frustration.

Since this topic is causing significant tension, it might be best to step away from it. Is there a subject regarding history, science, or a hobby that you usually find interesting? I would be happy to discuss something factual and grounded with you.
